description: Parse a User-Agent header into structured data: browser (name/version), rendering engine, operating system, and device type/vendor/model. Deterministic — the same string always parses identically. Use this when an agent needs to uA string → browser, engine, OS and device. x402 price $0.001/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
